premises.text: Contract workflows across drafts, approvals, negotiations, and signatures become chaotic when many reps juggle many contracts at once
premises.evidence_span: everybody hates dealing with contracts. But contracts are everywhere

premises.text: Glider's visual workflow builder composes document request, approval, and signature steps so the system handles requests and reminders without babysitting
premises.evidence_span: It's comprised of simple visual building blocks that each represent common tasks, things like requesting documents, getting approvals, and getting signatures

premises.text: Stakeholders get one-click links to view history, comment, approve, or sign, with immediate team notifications on each action
premises.evidence_span: Glider automatically sends a link where they can quickly view the entire document history, make quick comments, or approve and sign in just one click

premises.text: A management dashboard shows which deals are stuck in legal, negotiation, or final signature without chasing status updates
premises.evidence_span: Glider gives you a dashboard where you can see in one place how many deals are off in legal land, how many deals are stuck in internal or external negotiations, and how many deals are actually out for final customer signature

premises.text: Glider sits between CRMs and e-signature tools to shorten the painful middle of the contract close process
premises.evidence_span: On one side, you have the CRMs, Salesforce, Sage, SAP, Zoho. This is where everything gets started. And on the other side, you have the DocuSigns and the EchoSigns

value.text: Organizations make contract management drop-dead simple, shortening close times and keeping teams working together
value.evidence_span: we're on a mission to make managing this process drop dead simple

causal_links.evidence_span: Welcome to contract management as we know it today
Glider makes it incredibly easy to see how close each of your deals are to closing and keep track of which deals need your immediate attention
That's where Glider is shortening close times and keeping teams working together seamlessly

notes: Draft/approval/negotiation/signature chaos folded as one contract-process problem (§4.1.6).
